name: Thistleshrub Valley
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Have you ever seen Thistleshrub Valley? It's a mighty dangerous place, adventurer.

Those strange beasts there, I don't trust them for a minute! Gnarled thistleshrubs and thistleshrub rootshapers, that's what I think they were called...

Anyhow, I want to get into the valley, but with so many of those thistleshrubs around, there's no way I'm going back there. But here's where you come in -- if you clear some of them out, I just might think about going back. What do you think, adventurer? Help me out?
narrative.objectives: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.
narrative.offerRewardText:
They're that big? I might have to rethink my plan...

But you did hold up your end of the bargain, so here's what I promised.
narrative.requestItemsText: I'd like to take a closer look at that cactus in the valley... So leave some of it in one piece, will ya?
